x: There are others, too, Fox, Mewes, Edwards, Stone, Keyworth, to mention only a few names, who should establish Belgrave as the premier sprinting club within the course of a few years.

A programme of three events gave only a few of our Juniors a chance to show their merit; but Mewes, Crilly, Keyworth, Dyke, Martin, Chantler and Clements certainly seized the opportunity to show their superiority over the other clubs.
